retrieval_metadata_experiments.note: Member A metadata-aware experiments. Layered on the public retrieve() API via kingscode.metadata_experiments; they never replace R0-R5 nor change the default retrieval path. Metadata features are optional soft priors over a candidate union, never hard filters. Runnable on CPU in bm25 mode; neural (hybrid+rerank) variants are prepared for the target GPU only.

R6.definition: R3 + exact legal locator / metadata features (candidate union, soft re-rank)

R8.definition: R3 + diversification (collapse content mirrors, then diversify by canonical document)

rule: Retrieval-only experiments first. Freeze the selected exact evidence, then vary only decoder; precision fallback is a separate experiment.
